name: godot
description: Build it in Godot. Thirteen skills mined from the agent sessions of one long Godot build: bot balance loops and measure tables, a scripted balance model as the source of game data, upgrade-tree design with bot policies and human playtests, feature seams and save migrations, headless Godot runs without side effects, a headless GDScript test loop, frame-cost measurement, rendered-frame visual verification, palette-locked pixel art, procedural audio, release builds and store pages, safe refactors, and habits for a worker fleet on one game. The rules each skill measures against live in the game plugin's auditors.
